rationale: FX01 flags missing principal_amount_usd on rows asserted to have non-USD source par. The raw SOI schedule instead presents the Par Amount/ Units column as dollar-denominated: table 48 row 5 explicitly shows $ 9,875 for Central Parent, Inc., and table 49 row 3 explicitly shows $ 18,428 for Mews Systems B.V. Searches for EUR, currency, foreign, and denominated did not find source text indicating non-USD par for the schedule. The flag appears to arise from repeated blank currency-symbol cells in the table layout rather than an actual non-USD principal requiring FX conversion.
